[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Artifacts → Chats sub-tab with sync provenance and agent revival[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The ACE Artifacts tab gains a fifth "Chats" sub-tab that lists [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]every SASE chat transcript known to this machine — including remote[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]transcripts imported from the agents sidecar repo — makes each [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]transcript's sync provenance (local-only / shared / remote) [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]unmistakable at a glance, and lets the user jump from a chat [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]straight to its agent on the Agents tab, reviving that agent first [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]when it is dismissed.[/#D7D7AF]
